index-hero-meta-labels: Healthcare Consulting | Interim Management | Executive Coaching
index-hero-manifesto: Strategic and operational management through data-driven analysis for HomeCare, Spitex, MedTech, and health insurers—seamlessly connected across Germany and Switzerland.
index-hero-action-subtext: My areas of expertise, concepts, and solutions are diverse enough to address the wide range of opportunities, requirements, and challenges faced by my clients and projects.
index-matrix-subtitle: I combine clinical practice, sales, and management for HomeCare companies, Spitex & nursing services, MedTech, and payers in Germany and Switzerland.
index-matrix-pillar-1: Clinical Practice & Sales Balanced with deep boots-on-the-ground reality.
index-matrix-pillar-2: Clear Leadership Translating complex metrics into consistent execution.
index-matrix-pillar-3: Measurable Success Turning heavy commitment into structured operational yield.
index-divergence-p1: While traditional consulting often focuses solely on financial metrics, I integrate operational care, sales, leadership, and corporate management—with responsibility and foresight.
index-divergence-p2: I have firsthand knowledge of the challenges of the field and translate them into effective management systems—in both directions.
index-manifesto-quote: “I create systems that anyone can use to achieve above-average results.”
index-statement-title: No expensive PowerPoints. Just measurable results.
index-statement-quote: “As your personal sparring partner, I’ll guide you through close coaching and manage your projects hands-on until they succeed—no more high consulting fees with minimal results.”
index-focus-item-1: Research, identification & consistent minimization of direct and indirect costs.
index-focus-item-2: Optimization of the quality of care while simultaneously increasing economic efficiency.
index-focus-item-3: Evaluation of existing processes in complex care & supply concepts.
index-focus-quote: "Guided by skills that do not just exist on paper, but are economically proven in D-CH practice."
index-diff-title: What sets me apart from other healthcare management consultancies?
index-diff-subtitle: My combination of in-depth practical experience in the German healthcare system and leadership experience:
index-diff-text: I have navigated the German healthcare landscape in its entirety, led and developed sales teams. As Head of Sales in Switzerland, I turned around critical market regions and designed and developed new care models at the strategic level.
index-approach-subtitle: A rigorous, linear process designed to move healthcare organizations from ambiguity to absolute execution metrics.
index-phase1-desc: Uncovering operational realities, clinical friction points, and hidden cost drivers through structured data validation.
index-phase2-desc: Cutting through institutional noise to establish clear targets, focused resource alignment, and concrete roadmap parameters.
index-phase3-desc: Stepping onto the ground floor to drive change directly alongside internal teams, managing deployment hurdles hands-on.
index-phase4-desc: Delivering verified financial metrics, optimized clinical workflow pipelines, and sustainable operational growth values.
contact-models-intro: Maximum transparency, absolute flexibility, and a steadfast focus on results.Every mandate and every project within the regulated healthcare sector is unique.To provide you with maximum planning certainty, we tailor our approach precisely to your specific needs.
contact-promise-body: We believe in the measurable success of our work. For complex restructuring mandates or large-scale sales projects, we offer—upon request—a hybrid pricing model:A reduced base daily rate, coupled with a clearly defined, performance-based component (Success Fee) triggered upon the achievement of your project milestones.
contact-quote-body: Every proposal is custom-tailored. During a free, 30-minute initial consultation, we will analyze your specific challenges and provide you with a transparent fixed-price or mandate-specific proposal within 48 hours.
contact-subtitle: Let us shed economic light on your care concepts, strategies, and structures.

offerings-diff_li2: Revenue Evidence: Validated successes in the D-CH homecare sector (wounds, nutrition, stoma, incontinence, etc.).
